subtitulo: Offering the interpretation as a hypothesis
descripcion: At C2 feedback separates the observation from its interpretation explicitly, offering the interpretation as a hypothesis the other person can confirm or correct — rather than asserting it as fact — which turns feedback into a conversation instead of a verdict.

filas: The last three drafts came in after the deadline.
My guess is the scope keeps growing after we start — but tell me if that's off.
Does that match what's happening on your end?

ejemplos.texto: The last three drafts came in after the deadline. My guess is the scope keeps growing partway through — does that match what's happening?
I noticed you went quiet in that meeting. I don't know why, and I'd rather ask than assume.
That's my read on it, but you're closer to it than I am.

notas: Offering the interpretation as a hypothesis (my guess is) rather than a fact keeps the recipient's own account genuinely open, not just performed as open.
Explicitly checking (does that match?) turns the feedback into a two-way exchange rather than a one-way verdict.
You're closer to it than I am hands genuine authority back to the recipient about their own situation.

es.en: Spanish can frame an interpretation as tentative («a lo mejor me equivoco, pero…»), so the move exists. English uses a small set of fixed phrases for it (my reading is…, tell me if I've got this wrong) that are worth learning as units.
es.es: El español puede presentar una interpretación como tentativa («a lo mejor me equivoco, pero…»), por lo que el movimiento existe. El inglés usa un pequeño repertorio de fórmulas fijas («my reading is…», «tell me if I've got this wrong») que conviene aprender como unidades.

de.en: German has exact equivalents: «wenn ich das richtig verstehe» (if I've understood this correctly) and «korrigieren Sie mich, wenn ich falsch liege» (correct me if I'm wrong). The move therefore transfers directly.
de.de: Deutsch hat genaue Entsprechungen: «wenn ich das richtig verstehe» («if I've understood this correctly») und «korrigieren Sie mich, wenn ich falsch liege» («correct me if I'm wrong»). Die Gesprächsfunktion lässt sich daher direkt übertragen.

it.en: «Correggimi se sbaglio» corresponds exactly to correct me if I'm wrong, so offering an interpretation as a hypothesis transfers directly. My reading is… is a useful additional formula.
it.it: «Correggimi se sbaglio» corrisponde esattamente a «correct me if I'm wrong», quindi presentare un'interpretazione come ipotesi si trasferisce direttamente. «My reading is…» è una formula aggiuntiva utile.

fr.en: «Corrigez-moi si je me trompe» corresponds exactly to correct me if I'm wrong, so the move transfers directly. My reading is… is a useful additional formula.
fr.fr: «Corrigez-moi si je me trompe» correspond exactement à «correct me if I'm wrong» ; le mouvement se transfère donc directement. «My reading is…» est une formule supplémentaire utile.

pt.en: «Corrige-me se estiver enganado» corresponds exactly to correct me if I'm wrong, so the move transfers directly. My reading is… is a useful additional formula.
pt.pt: «Corrige-me se estiver enganado» ou, no Brasil, «me corrija se eu estiver enganado» corresponde exatamente a «correct me if I'm wrong», então a função se transfere diretamente. «My reading is…» é uma fórmula adicional útil.

errores: Stating an interpretation as fact rather than as a checkable hypothesis.
Asking a checking question rhetorically, without genuine openness to being told the interpretation is wrong.
Skipping the observation and going straight to interpretation, so there's nothing concrete to check against.

es: «*Tengo la sensación de que*» rendered as *I have the sensation that* instead of *I get the sense that*.
de: «*Mir kommt es so vor, als*» rendered as *It comes to me like* instead of *It strikes me that*.
it: «*Ho la sensazione che*» rendered as *I have the sensation that* instead of *I get the sense that*.
fr: «*J'ai le sentiment que*» rendered as *I have the sentiment that* instead of *I get the sense that*.
pt: «*Tenho a sensação de que*» rendered as *I have the sensation that* instead of *I get the sense that*.

vocabulario.item: to take something with a pinch of salt

traducciones.fr: jeter de l'huile sur le feu

redemittel.expresion: My guess is…, but tell me if that's off.

traducciones.es: Mi impresión es…, pero dime si me equivoco.
traducciones.de: Mein Eindruck ist…, aber sag mir, wenn ich danebenliege.
traducciones.fr: Mon impression est…, mais dis-moi si je me trompe.
traducciones.it: La mia impressione è…, ma dimmi se sbaglio.
traducciones.pt: A minha impressão é…, mas diz-me se estiver enganado/a.

redemittel.expresion: Does that match what's happening on your end?

traducciones.es: ¿Eso coincide con lo que está pasando de tu lado?
traducciones.de: Entspricht das dem, was bei euch passiert?
traducciones.fr: Est-ce que cela correspond à ce qui se passe de votre côté ?
traducciones.it: Corrisponde a ciò che sta succedendo da voi?

redemittel.expresion: I noticed…, and I don't know why.

traducciones.es: Noté…, y no sé por qué.
traducciones.de: Mir ist… aufgefallen, und ich weiß nicht warum.
traducciones.fr: J’ai remarqué…, et je ne sais pas pourquoi.
traducciones.it: Ho notato…, e non so perché.
traducciones.pt: Reparei em…, e não sei porquê.

redemittel.expresion: That's my read on it, but you're closer to it than I am.

traducciones.es: Esa es mi lectura, pero tú estás más cerca del tema que yo.
traducciones.de: So sehe ich das, aber du bist näher dran als ich.
traducciones.fr: C’est ma lecture, mais tu es plus proche du sujet que moi.
traducciones.it: Questa è la mia lettura, ma tu sei più vicino/a alla questione di me.
traducciones.pt: Essa é a minha leitura, mas tu estás mais próximo/a do assunto do que eu.

redemittel.expresion: Correct me if I've got this wrong.

traducciones.de: Korrigiere mich, wenn ich das falsch verstanden habe.

redemittel.expresion: What's your take on why that happened?

traducciones.es: ¿Cuál es tu impresión de por qué pasó eso?
traducciones.de: Wie erklärst du dir, warum das passiert ist?
traducciones.fr: Selon toi, pourquoi cela s’est-il produit ?
traducciones.it: Qual è la tua lettura del perché sia successo?
traducciones.pt: Qual é a tua leitura sobre porque é que isso aconteceu?

redemittel.expresion: I may be pattern-matching on something that isn't there.
redemittel.funcion: flags the risk in one's own reading

traducciones.es: Puede que esté viendo un patrón que no existe.
traducciones.de: Womöglich sehe ich ein Muster, das es nicht gibt.
traducciones.fr: Je vois peut-être un motif qui n'existe pas.
traducciones.it: Forse sto vedendo uno schema che non c'è.
traducciones.pt: Posso estar a ver um padrão que não existe.

redemittel.expresion: Two readings fit what I saw.
redemittel.funcion: offers competing interpretations of the same fact

traducciones.es: Lo que vi admite dos lecturas.
traducciones.de: Auf das, was ich gesehen habe, passen zwei Deutungen.
traducciones.fr: Ce que j'ai vu admet deux lectures.
traducciones.it: Quel che ho visto ammette due letture.
traducciones.pt: O que vi admite duas leituras.

redemittel.expresion: Is this worth your attention, or should I drop it?
redemittel.funcion: lets them set the weight of the feedback

traducciones.de: Ist das Ihre Aufmerksamkeit wert, oder lasse ich es?
traducciones.fr: Cela mérite-t-il votre attention, ou j'abandonne ?
traducciones.it: Vale la sua attenzione o lascio perdere?
traducciones.pt: Isto merece a tua atenção ou deixo?

redemittel.expresion: I only see the output, not the constraints you were under.

traducciones.es: Yo solo veo el resultado, no las restricciones que tenías.
traducciones.de: Ich sehe nur das Ergebnis, nicht Ihre Rahmenbedingungen.
traducciones.fr: Je ne vois que le résultat, pas les contraintes que vous aviez.
traducciones.it: Vedo solo il risultato, non i vincoli che aveva.
traducciones.pt: Só vejo o resultado, não as restrições que tinhas.

redemittel.expresion: Would it help if I said what I'd have done instead?
redemittel.funcion: offers an alternative only if invited

traducciones.es: ¿Te sirve si te digo qué habría hecho yo?
traducciones.de: Hilft es, wenn ich sage, was ich stattdessen gemacht hätte?
traducciones.fr: Cela aiderait-il que je dise ce que j'aurais fait ?
traducciones.it: Aiuta se dico che cosa avrei fatto io?
traducciones.pt: Ajuda se eu disser o que teria feito?

redemittel.expresion: Let's look again in a fortnight rather than now.
redemittel.funcion: defers the feedback to a better moment

traducciones.es: Mejor lo miramos en dos semanas y no ahora.
traducciones.de: Schauen wir in zwei Wochen noch einmal darauf, nicht jetzt.
traducciones.fr: Reprenons cela dans quinze jours plutôt que maintenant.
traducciones.it: Rivediamolo tra due settimane, non adesso.
traducciones.pt: Vejamos outra vez daqui a duas semanas, não agora.

mision.consigna: Give feedback to a colleague whose newsletter pieces have started to read as one-sided.
requisitos: the interpretation offered as something they can correct
one question that genuinely hands them the floor
use *editorial slant*, *to be skewed* and *to sensationalise*

microtareas.texto: Write three observations about a text you disagree with — no interpretation at all.
Add your interpretation to each as a hypothesis: *My guess is…, but tell me if that's off.*
Record 2 minutes giving feedback on a piece of *clickbait* as if to its author.

autochequeo: Is the observation stated separately from the interpretation?
Is the interpretation offered as a checkable hypothesis, not a fact?
Is the checking question genuinely open, not rhetorical?
Does the recipient's account remain genuinely possible to differ?
Is there a concrete observation underlying the feedback?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on whether the observation and interpretation are kept separate, and whether the interpretation is offered as a genuine hypothesis. Do not rewrite the text.
